leadText:
Christopher (Japanese: カラザ Karaza) and Jeannie (Japanese: キミ Kimi) are characters of the day who appeared in May's Egg-cellent Adventure. They are husband and wife, and own a Kanto breeding center with their daughter Nicolette.

The couple invite and into their house after Nicolette recognized as the winner of the Saffron City . Christopher told the group about his and Jeannie's job as farm ranchers and gave the group a tour of the nursery storage areas, stocked full of Eggs,

While they were having dinner, Christopher, Jeannie, and the group went outside and noticed a giant Egg left by with a note attached to it. Reading the note, they wheeled the Egg into the storage room for its safety while Christopher and Jeannie showed the group an incubator that holds Eggs that are about to hatch. Unfortunately, the giant Egg was a mecha that was controlling and it went ahead and stole many of the Eggs in the storage rooms. Christopher and Jeannie watched as Nicolette and May took on Team Rocket. Jeannie recovered one of the Eggs and Christopher and the group recovered the rest of the them.

After finished Team Rocket off with , the group watched as 's Egg hatched the next morning. For helping Nicolette out with her confidence, Christopher rewarded May with an before she and her friends resume their travels.
